Hon'ble G. Narendar, C.J. 
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
 Mr. Sagar Kothari, learned counsel for the 
appellant. 
2. Mr. S.S. Chauhan and Mr. Mukesh Rawat, 
learned counsel for respondent Nos. 1 and 2. 
3. We have seen the impugned endorsement issued 
by respondent No. 2. It is quite apparent that 
respondent No. 2 is taking sides in the inter-se dispute 
between the partners. On the one hand, they do not 
supply the fuel and on the other hand, they threaten 
the retailer that if he does not resume operations, they 
would be constrained to put the retail operator on 
holiday scheme. 
4. Respondent No. 2 shall explain as to how the 
appeal can continue the retail operations without supply 
of fuel. 
5. List on 07.03.2025. 
6. In the event, we are not satisfied with the reply, 
the same would be viewed seriously and the officer, 
who has issued the impugned endorsement, shall suffer 
consequences. 
7. Let a copy of this order be furnished to the  counsel for respondent Nos. 1 and 2 today itself, as per 
rules. 
 (Alok Mahra, J) (G. Narendar, CJ) 
 06.03.2025 06.03.2025 
Rathour

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS 
12.03.2025 SPA No. 19 of 2025
Hon’ble G. Narendar, C.J.
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
1. Heard Sri Sagar Kothari, learned counsel for the 
appellant and Sri R.K. Raizada, learned Senior Counsel 
assisted by Sri S.S. Chauhan, learned counsel for 
respondent nos. 1 & 2. 
2. Sri Nishant Kumar, Territory Manager of the second 
respondent to file his affidavit, detailing what are the 
“threats” faced by the BPCL, which convinced the 
Territory Manager to resort to such extreme action of 
stopping supplies, and further directing them to resume 
retail operations, without supplying raw material, and 
what are the grounds for him to reasonably conclude that 
the firm has to be placed in the holiday scheme. The 
facts would reveal that the actions of the Territory 
Manager are akin to tying down ones hand, and asking 
him to wrestle. 
3. In any way, this Court would be better positioned 
to proceed further on the facts that may be deposed by 
the Territory Manager. The affidavit of the Territory 
Manager to be positively placed before this Court by the 
next date of hearing. 
4. List this case on 19.03.2025. 
5. A copy of this order be forwarded to the Territory 
Manager on his e-mail Id, i.e. 
nishantkumar@bharatpetroleum.in. 
 
 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) (G. Narendar, C.J.) 
 12.03.2025 12.03.2025
Rahul
